workload.document_keys: synthetic distinct keys; no document bodies

method: Same harness in both trees. Alternate baseline/candidate order; replay has one untallied warm-up per process. Every persisted vector dataset is reread and validated. Journal setup excluded from replay timing; vector checkpoint reported separately.
limitations: Native macOS ARM64 shared host; no Docker CPU/memory envelope or OpenAI calls.
Replay timings include diagnostic allocator overhead; vector timing runs use the original uninstrumented SMP allocator.
Allocation counts cover the passed allocator, not every direct libc allocation; peak requested live bytes are not RSS.
No measured reduction in peak live heap. Single-record-per-document replay timing is variable; do not claim zero overhead.

Text/algebraic replay timing uses a validating consumer and excludes downstream document parsing/indexing. Graph and full-document throughput have not been benchmarked; real-body correctness is checked separately by database integration fixtures.
build_command: python3 tools/run_bounded_zig_build.py --max-rss-cap 15032385536 -- build replay-allocation-test replay-document-integration-test vector-payload-test replay-allocation-bench vector-payload-bench -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dmetal=false -Dcuda=false -Donnx=false -j1 --summary all

budget_regressions: Descriptor admission/deduplication during collection; finish requires no new admission.
Slice and aggregate hard limits with complete replay progress for text/algebraic/dense/sparse document descriptors.
Full item windows stop before decoding oversized lookahead; admission-denied lookahead yields an already collected window.
Deferred and admission-denied records retain their cursor position and replay exactly once after retry.
Oversized full-text records that fit the hard budget apply bounded subchunks before advancing the record sequence.

budget_fix_followup.method: Seven measured samples and one untallied warm-up in each process; journal setup once per variant/case. Variant order alternates between cases, not between samples. Same diagnostic counter and validating consumer; shared macOS host. Timings are diagnostic and exclude indexing.
budget_fix_followup.candidate_changes: Descriptor admission during collection, lookahead admission yielding, decoder credit release, bounded headroom checks.
limitations: Integration compilation and unrelated workloads were active on the shared host; timing changes are diagnostic, not a throughput guarantee.
Seven measured samples per variant/case reuse the journal in one process; these are not seven alternating paired process runs.
Allocation counts and peak requested live bytes are identical to the original candidate measurements for all six remeasured cases.
